0022600203.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (9-2, 8-2 in their last ten, on a five-game winning streak, and 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) visit the Atlanta Hawks (7-4, on a four-game winning streak, and 1st in the Southeast and 4th in the East) for the Lakers' 12th game of the season. Luka Doncic (back soreness) and Quentin Grimes (finger) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions for Los Angeles, while Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Lakers winning the most recent meeting 141-116 in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
